prompt_text: Best donor CRM with online giving built in
response_text:
**Bloomerang is the top-recommended donor CRM with built-in online giving for nonprofits in 2026.**  
It functions as a unified giving platform that integrates donor management, online fundraising, engagement tools, and reporting to strengthen relationships and boost funds[1][8].  

### Other Strong Options with Built-in Online Giving
Several platforms stand out for combining CRM functionality and native online donation capabilities, based on 2026 reviews:

| Platform      | Key Features with Online Giving                                                                 | Pricing/Notes                  |
|---------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------|
| **DonorDock** | All-in-one at $500/month: CRM, email, online giving, text, project management, AI[5].           | Flat rate, comprehensive plan. |
| **Funraise**  | Focuses on growing online giving while tracking donor journeys[6].                              | Fundraising-centric platform.  |
| **Giveffect** | Manages donors, tracks contributions, enhances fundraising efforts[3].                          | Emphasizes supporter relationships. |
| **Kindful**   | Listed among impactful tools for donor management and online fundraising[6].                    | Part of broader nonprofit software reviews. |

DonorPerfect excels in donor management and fundraising but lacks explicit mention of built-in online giving in sources, focusing instead on tracking and mailing[4]. Platforms like Omatic integrate online giving into existing CRMs (e.g., Salesforce) rather than providing it natively[9]. For simpler needs, Bloomerang prioritizes ease of use and donor retention[8]. Selections prioritize sources highlighting 2026 relevance and native integration[1][2][3][5][6][7][8].
